<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><span style="font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><b>Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election
of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><b>Departure of Principal Executive Officer</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">On October 26, 2026, the Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;)
of American Fusion, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) approved a change in executive leadership, effective immediately upon valid approval
of the Board resolution. Richard C. Hawkins ceased serving as Chief Executive Officer and Corporate Secretary of the Company effective
October 26, 2026. Mr. Hawkins was appointed Chief Administrative Officer (&#8220;CAO&#8221;), subject to his acceptance, and is expected
to continue serving the Company in that capacity. His departure from the Chief Executive Officer position does not, by itself, constitute
a departure from any position as a director.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">During his tenure, Mr. Hawkins served as Chief Executive Officer on a non-salaried
basis. He separately provided strategic corporate, financial and capital markets services to the Company on a non-exclusive basis under
a Consulting Services Agreement dated January 1, 2025 (the &#8220;Consulting Agreement&#8221;). The Consulting Agreement was filed as
Exhibit 10.4 to the Company&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form 10 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 12,
2026, and is incorporated herein by reference. The Consulting Agreement remains in effect and is not being amended or terminated in connection
with the change in Mr. Hawkins&#8217; title.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><b>Appointment of Principal Executive Officer</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">On October 26, 2026, the Board appointed Brent Nelson, to succeed
Richard C. Hawkins as Chief Executive Officer of the Company, effective immediately. Mr. Nelson, who has served as Executive Chairman
of the Board since March 1, 2026, will continue to serve as Chairman of the Board. The Board also appointed Michael G. Smith, age 66,
to succeed Richard C. Hawkins as the Corporate Secretary of the Company, effective immediately.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><span style="line-height: 115%">Mr. Nelson currently provides
services to the Company under a consulting services agreement dated March 1, 2026 (the &#8220;Nelson Consulting Agreement&#8221;), under
which Mr. Nelson receives compensation of $15,000 per month. </span>The Company may, in its sole and absolute discretion, award additional
compensation or bonuses from time to time in recognition of services rendered, milestones achieved, transactions completed, or other extraordinary
contributions. The term of the <span style="line-height: 115%">Nelson Consulting Agreement</span> shall be for six months and automatically
renew for successive six-month periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least thirty days prior to the expiration
of the then-current term. The foregoing description of the Nelson Consulting Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified
in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Nelson Consulting Agreement, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this Current
Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt/115% Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The Nelson Consulting Agreement was not entered into or amended
in connection with Mr. Nelson&#8217;s appointment as Chief Executive Officer and remains in effect. Other than the Nelson Consulting Agreement,
as of the date of this Current Report on Form 8-K, the Company has not entered into any material plan, contract or arrangement with Mr.
Nelson, and no grant or award has been made to Mr. Nelson, in connection with his appointment as Chief Executive Officer, and the terms
of any such arrangement have not yet been determined. The Company will file an amendment to this Current Report on Form 8-K within four
business days after the material terms of any such arrangement are determined, as required by Instruction 2 to Item 5.02 of Form 8-K.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Brent Nelson, age 65, is a technology entrepreneur, venture
investor and business executive with more than 30 years of experience in energy, aerospace, healthcare and advanced technology. During
the past five years, Mr. Nelson has served as founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Kepler Aerospace, a technology platform
company focused on propulsion, advanced energy and space-related technologies, and has served in leadership roles with American Fusion,
Inc. and American EcoFuels Inc., including as Chairman and director of each company. His activities include oversight of the Kepler-related
businesses Kepler Fusion Technologies, Kepler GTL Technologies, Kepler Medical, Kepler Gravity Sciences, Kepler Electrical and Kepler
Space Ventures. He is also affiliated with Quantum Investment Fund I and Earth Sciences Fund I, where he participates in capital formation
and strategic investment initiatives.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></p>

    <div style="border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; margin-bottom: 6pt"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%"><tr><td style="text-align: center; width: 100%">&#160;</td></tr></table></div>
    <div style="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%"><tr><td style="text-align: center; width: 100%">&#160;</td></tr></table></div>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Earlier in his career, Mr. Nelson founded or co-founded businesses
including a company that developed technology later associated with Windows Media Player, Palmworks, CybeRecord, Evader, RF Surgical
Systems and Mobile PET Systems. His experience also includes natural-resources development projects in South America and Australia. The
Board selected Mr. Nelson to succeed Mr. Hawkins in view of his experience with technology development, corporate strategy, financing
and management.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">Mr. Nelson does not have a family relationship with any of the current officers
or directors of the Company.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><i>Related Party Transactions</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Except for the Nelson Consulting Agreement described above and the
transactions described in the Company&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form 10 and its Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q for the quarters
ended March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026, including the share exchange pursuant to which the Company acquired Kepler from Mr. Nelson and
Mr. Nelson&#8217;s acquisition, through Earth Sciences Fund I LLC, of the Special 2020 Series A Preferred Control Share, there are no
transactions in which Mr. Nelson has an interest requiring disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K.</p>
